name: DataForSEO
one_liner: DataForSEO offers RESTful SEO data APIs with pay‑as‑you‑go pricing and an MCP server for AI assistants.
auth_notes: Basic Authentication using login and password encoded in Base64.
access_notes: Pay‑as‑you‑go model with $1 free trial credit and $50 minimum deposit.

extras.rate_limits: Rate limit HTTP headers we use: X-RateLimit-Limit – the rate limit ceiling per minute for the given endpoint; X-RateLimit-Remaining – the number of requests remaining in the current rate limit window.

evidence.snippet: DataForSEO is using the Basic Authentication, which makes it possible to call our APIs with almost any programming language, Postman app, REST API platforms, and all major frameworks.
DataForSEO API is using the REST technology for interchanging data between your application and our service.
The DataForSEO MCP server connects Claude, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible agent to seven live SEO APIs.
Create a free account with DataForSEO, then go to the API Access tab in the account dashboard to find your API login and password, which you’ll need to authenticate and use the DataForSEO APIs.
